title: ContentTaxonomyRelatedTerm - Data API
description: Represents the relationship between a term and the content taxonomy to which the term belongs. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

ContentTaxonomyId.description: The ID of the content taxonomy to which the term belongs. This field is a relationship field.

ContentTaxonomyTermId.description: The ID of the term that belongs to the content taxonomy. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To view this object, users need the permission View Content Taxonomy enabled. To edit this object, users need View Content Taxonomy and Manage Content Taxonomy enabled.
usage: To include a term in a taxonomy, you must use this object in addition to the ContentTaxonomyTerm and ContentTaxonomy objects.

        <element name="ContentTaxonomyId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="ContentTaxonomyTerm" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:ContentTaxonomyTerm"/>
        <element name="ContentTaxonomyTermId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>

        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>

</complexType>
